title: Sagar Setu — fisherman question bank
about: Questions small-craft fishermen realistically ask, across every question type the system handles, in English, Tamil, Hindi and Malayalam, including colloquial, misspelled and code-mixed phrasing. Each entry records the EXPECTED UNDERSTANDING (type, place, day, time, boat), not an expected answer: the correct answer to 'is it safe tomorrow' changes every day, so answers are judged by behaviour (verdict present, numbers verified, right language), never by fixed text.
